content.value_statement: Database work often spans design, migrations, optimization, and operations. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured workflow for database tasks.
actual_capabilities: Guides schema design with database architecture, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL phases.
Organizes ORM setup, migration planning, seed data, and implementation steps.
Provides query optimization checkpoints for slow queries, plans, indexes, and caching.
Covers data pipelines with ingestion, transformations, scheduling, and monitoring.
Includes database operations tasks for backups, replication, capacity, and security.
Lists quality gates for migrations, benchmarks, backups, monitoring, and documentation.
limitations: Does not include runnable scripts or database client code.
Relies on referenced skills that may need separate installation.
Does not validate real schemas, queries, migrations, or credentials.
Requires user-provided database context and environment constraints.

use_cases.title: Design a New Data Model
use_cases.description: Plan entities, relationships, indexing, scalability, and review checkpoints before implementation.

use_cases.title: Prepare Database Operations
use_cases.description: Organize backup, replication, monitoring, capacity, and security tasks for an existing database.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Data Pipelines
use_cases.description: Structure ingestion, transformations, scheduling, quality checks, and monitoring for data workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Schema Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the database workflow to plan a new application schema. Include entities, relationships, indexes, and validation questions.

prompt_templates.title: Review Migration Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the database workflow to review my planned migration. Check rollback strategy, test data, downtime risks, and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Query Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the database workflow to analyze slow query symptoms. Recommend index, query, caching, and monitoring actions before production changes.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Data Platform Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the database workflow to plan a data pipeline and warehouse update. Cover ingestion, transformations, quality gates, scheduling, and observability.

output_examples.input: I need a PostgreSQL schema for orders, customers, and payments.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a phased schema plan with relationships, index candidates, migration checkpoints, and questions about volume and consistency.

output_examples.input: A nightly data pipeline is failing quality checks.
output_examples.output: The skill organizes debugging around ingestion, transformations, validation metrics, monitoring gaps, and clear handoffs to data engineering skills.
The skill outlines planning steps for rollback, testing, data integrity checks, backup readiness, and post-migration verification.

best_practices: Provide current schema, database engine, workload patterns, and production constraints.
Ask for review checkpoints before applying migrations or index changes.
Validate every recommendation in a staging environment with representative data.
anti_patterns: Do not use the workflow as approval to run unreviewed database changes.
Do not omit backup, rollback, or data integrity requirements.
Do not assume referenced skills are installed or authorized.

faq.question: Does this skill run database commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and prompt routing. It does not include executable scripts or database clients.

faq.question: Which databases does it mention?
faq.answer: It covers SQL and NoSQL workflows, with references to PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, ClickHouse, Prisma, Neon, Airflow, and dbt.

faq.question: Can it replace a database administrator?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure work, but production decisions need environment-specific validation and expert review.

faq.question: Does it create migrations automatically?
faq.answer: No. It guides migration planning and points to migration-focused skills for implementation support.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide schema goals, database engine, workload details, data volume, compliance needs, and operational constraints.
